description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Axon develops devices and cloud software focused on protecting life and addressing critical safety and justice issues. The Software Engineer will design, build, test, deploy, and maintain reliable, scalable software and services while partnering with cross-functional teams to solve customer problems. Depending on experience, the role may also involve owning technical projects, shaping architecture, mentoring engineers, and improving engineering productivity through automation and AI-assisted workflows.
Software engineer building cloud-based distributed systems and owning production features, architecture, reliability, and testing.

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production software and services
• Own features and technical projects from requirements through production
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture design
• Build highly available, scalable, and performant systems for mission-critical products
• Work with modern cloud, distributed systems, data, and open-source technologies
• Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to build solutions that solve real customer problems
• Use AI-assisted development tools, automation, and intelligent workflows to improve engineering productivity and software quality
• Validate and critically evaluate AI-generated code and technical recommendations
• Improve testing, observability, reliability, and operational efficiency
• Contribute to engineering processes and technical best practices
• Learn from experienced engineers and share your knowledge with others
• At more senior levels, provide technical leadership, influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and help raise the technical bar across teams

Requirements:
• A foundation in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent practical experience
• Experience programming in languages such as Java, Go, Scala, C#, Python, C++, or similar
• Experience or interest in building backend services, APIs, cloud applications, distributed systems, or other production software
• Familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
• An understanding of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and system design appropriate to your experience level
• Curiosity about modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development, code generation, and automation
• A commitment to writing reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills
• A desire to understand customer problems and build technology that makes a meaningful impact

Preferred:
• Experience designing and delivering highly available, scalable cloud-based systems
• Ownership of production services and complex technical projects
• Strong system design and architecture experience
• Experience making and communicating engineering tradeoffs
• Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction
• Experience improving developer workflows through automation or AI-assisted engineering practices
